Separate the next questions: (1)recheck short/medium candidate coverage on another verified training/development pool, repair failed reward controls, and run fixed-A restricted standard DAPO versus zero update with independent quality/semantic evaluation; (2)if broad long-segment strength remains the goal, first screen starts with demonstrable English-Icelandic ability on verified technical data, then change only one SFT adaptation factor, such as LoRA rank, under matched data/budget.
